title: 耦合电感的同侧并联
statement: U̇s = 15∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 3 Ω。耦合电感 L_1 = 5 mH、L_2 = 8 mH、M = 2 mH 并联，两线圈的同名端接在同一结点上（同侧并联）。
求总电流 I 及两条支路电流 I_1、I_2 的有效值，并判断异侧并联时的等效电感。

questions.ask: L_1 支路电流有效值 I_1 = ?
questions.explain: 两线圈电压相等：jωL_1·İ1 + jωM·İ2 = jωM·İ1 + jωL_2·İ2 → (5 − 2)İ1 = (8 − 2)İ2 → İ1 = 2İ2；İ1 + İ2 = İ → I_1 = 2 A。

questions.ask: L_2 支路电流有效值 I_2 = ?
questions.explain: İ2 = İ / 3，I_2 = 1 A。注意 I_1 + I_2 = I：两支路电流同相（都是纯电感性的支路，没有电阻）。

questions.ask: 若 L_2 两端对调（异侧并联），等效电感变为多少？

hints: 两条支路电压相同，各写一个含互感电压的方程，再加上 KCL：İ = İ1 + İ2。
同侧并联的等效电感 L_eq = (L_{1}L_{2} − M²)/(L_1 + L_2 − 2M)，也可以先用 T 形去耦等效（L_1 − M、L_2 − M 两支路并联后再串 M）求得。
solution: **1. 支路方程。** 两个电流都从同名端（上端）流入，设并联电压为 U̇：U̇ = jωL_1·İ1 + jωM·İ2 = jωM·İ1 + jωL_2·İ2。代入数值（Ω）：U̇ = j5İ1 + j2İ2 = j2İ1 + j8İ2 → 3İ1 = 6İ2，İ1 = 2İ2。

en.title: Coupled inductors in parallel, dots on the same side
statement: U_s = 15∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R = 3 Ω. The coupled inductors L_1 = 5 mH, L_2 = 8 mH, M = 2 mH are in parallel with both dotted terminals on the same node (parallel aiding).
Find the rms total current I and the rms branch currents I_1 and I_2, and the equivalent inductance if the dots were on opposite sides.

questions.explain: Both coils have the same voltage: jωL_1·I_1 + jωM·I_2 = jωM·I_1 + jωL_2·I_2 → (5 − 2)I_1 = (8 − 2)I_2 → I_1 = 2I_2; with I_1 + I_2 = I, I_1 = 2 A.
I_2 = I / 3, so I_2 = 1 A. Here I_1 + I_2 = I exactly: both branches are purely inductive, so their currents are in phase.

questions.ask: If the ends of L_2 are swapped (dots on opposite sides), the equivalent inductance becomes…
questions.explain: Dots on opposite sides: L_eq = (L_{1}L_{2} − M²)/(L_1 + L_2 + 2M) = 36 / 17 ≈ 2.12 mH, smaller than the same-side value.

hints: Both branches have the same voltage: write one equation per branch, each with its mutual-voltage term, plus KCL: I = I_1 + I_2.
For dots on the same side, L_eq = (L_{1}L_{2} − M²)/(L_1 + L_2 − 2M); you can also get it from the T (decoupled) equivalent: (L_1 − M) ∥ (L_2 − M) in series with M.
solution: **1. Branch equations.** Both currents enter at the dots (top). With parallel voltage U: U = jωL_1·I_1 + jωM·I_2 = jωM·I_1 + jωL_2·I_2. In ohms: U = j5I_1 + j2I_2 = j2I_1 + j8I_2 → 3I_1 = 6I_2, I_1 = 2I_2.
**2. Equivalent inductance.** U = j(5 × 2 + 2)I_2 = j12I_2 and I = 3I_2, so U/I = j4 Ω → L_eq = **4 mH**. (Decoupling: M in series with (L_1 − M)∥(L_2 − M) = 2 + 3∥6 = 4 mH, the same.)
